summary: HRE variant with gilded units that are much stronger but cost more and take twice the population. Villagers gather faster and carry more.

spikes.label: Gilded Spearmen
spikes.detail: Gilded units are strong from the Dark Age but there are few of them.
spikes.answer: Out-number them; archers and ranged units trade well.

spikes.label: Early Gilded Men-at-Arms
spikes.detail: Early Gilded Men-at-Arms arrive in Feudal and are very tough.
spikes.answer: Use crossbows and towers; avoid melee.

scout: Relics garrisoned in towers and keeps
